organization_and_why.profile_excerpt: Fresh produce hub with walk-in refrigeration and our own reefer truck. Roughly 600 households weekly, and perishables move through us in under two days.

whose_neighborhood.tract: Nearest census tract: 9% of residents below the poverty line, 11% of households without a vehicle, 12% on food or cash assistance (ACS; recipient location is ZIP-level, so this is the area, not the exact block).

outreach_message:
Hello Maple Street Produce Alliance team,

A farm south of Chicago has 5 tons of potatoes. It is still good but has to move soon. From what we have on file you have the storage for it. The food needs to leave by about 72 hours from now, which leaves you roughly 60 hours of slack to collect. You are set up to collect it yourselves.

Can you take it? If you can, tell us the time you can collect and a phone number for pickup. If not, a quick no helps us move to the next place.

Thank you,
[Coordinator name]
